name: dyn08_reduced
notes: DYN-08 (EXP-036) REDUCED design, docs/dyn08_plan.md. Real Belauri geography (padded 500 m grid), WorldPop weights, ERA5-derived uniform wind histories, SYNTHETIC emissions/episodes/noise. Not empirical validation. Every value here is part of the pre-registration and is frozen before any layout is designed; the cost block holds MEASURED constants (docs/dyn08_plan.md section 3).

seeds.note: Disjoint from every spent/declared range (USED_SEEDS in dynamic_belauri.py). Each block is 1000 wide. wind_selection/design_layouts feed seeded RNG streams only; validation 46000-46047; test 43000-43191; dev/pilot/smoke seeds >= 49000 never enter a claim.

hp_grid.note: exponents (start, stop inclusive, step) of 10**e; M0/M1: alpha_m; M2: alpha_2 x {0, 10**beta_exp}; tuned on the SPREAD layout per (k, noise) on validation episodes only

model_error.note: truth perturbed, inverse nominal, layouts and hyperparameters frozen; run on a SUBSET of the test episodes (first seed of each wind x family); the matched condition is the test stage's own rows for those episodes. rot5/10/20 mirror DYN-07 (F-049); mesh250 = truth on the 250 m padded level block-averaged onto 500 m (a proxy for numerical error, not a mesh-adequacy test, F-048 void).

cost.unit: core-hours = single-core wall seconds / 3600. Constants below were measured on the local WSL2 workstation (16 logical CPUs) on 2026-10-15 UNDER LOAD (load average 13: another job occupied ~13 CPUs), so they are about 2x the lightly-loaded values (5.5 s per dt-100 solve measured earlier in the session). Cluster-core speed is NOT measured: first cluster action = `--stage time` on one core (~10 min).

idle_reference.note: measured with 3 of my own processes and little other load; probable lower bound

cost.row_overhead_note: row_overhead_ms = S.jpop per fitted row (measured 2.5 ms); episode_fixed_s = reference scale + live mask + projection floor per episode (measured ~1.8 s)
cost.tune_note: tune_cell_episode_s = full hyperparameter grid (12 M1 + 96 M2 candidates, incl. J_pop rows) on ONE episode in ONE (k, noise) cell: measured 0.9-5.8 s (mean 3.0), 0 non-converged of 864 fits, max single fit 0.86 s (2 episodes x 4 cells, wind 4)
